findings.title: firstName returns the LAST name, not the first name
findings.body: The function promises 'first name' but returns the second word (last name). For 'Ada Lovelace', it returns 'Lovelace' when it should return 'Ada'. This is an off-by-one error: it uses index [1] instead of [0].

findings.title: No handling for single-word names or empty strings
findings.body: Single names like 'Ada' cause undefined to appear in the greeting message: 'Welcome back, undefined!'
findings.suggestion: Add handling: const parts = name.trim().split(" "); return parts[0] || name;

findings.title: Test only checks prefix, misses the actual value
findings.body: The test uses toMatch(/^Welcome back, /) which passes even when firstName returns undefined. It should verify the actual name extracted.
